WITH time_window_1 AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(mtp.time) AS day
  FROM meteo_tp AS mtp
  WHERE
    (
      ROUND(CAST(mtp.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1),
      ROUND(CAST(mtp.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1)
    ) IN ((47.4, 8.5))
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mtp.time) = 2018
  GROUP BY
    DATE(mtp.time)
  HAVING
    SUM(mtp.tp) > 0.0001
), streaks AS (
  SELECT
    time_window_1.day AS day,
    (
      time_window_1.day - (
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time_window_1.day) * INTERVAL '1 DAY'
      )
    ) AS grp
  FROM time_window_1
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS duration
FROM streaks
GROUP BY
  streaks.grp
ORDER BY
  duration DESC
LIMIT 1

question: Find the average mean temperature in Celsius for the parts of City of Zurich with lakes between 2018 and 2019.
fit_reason: join on an elevation filter: provenance shows which cells passed it, though the aggregate still covers all their readings
sql:
WITH water_grids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    u.latitude,
    u.longitude
  FROM landcover_upscaled AS u
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(u.ranks) WITH ORDINALITY AS r ( code, idx )
  JOIN landcover_type AS lt
    ON lt.level3_code = r.code
  WHERE
    (ROUND(CAST(u.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1), ROUND(CAST(u.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1)) IN ((47.4, 8.5))
    AND lt.level3_label ILIKE '%water%'
    AND r.idx % 2 = 1
), time_window_3 AS (
  SELECT
    t.latitude,
    t.longitude,
    AVG(t.tmean) AS time_window_5
  FROM meteo_tmean AS t
  JOIN water_grids AS lg
    ON lg.latitude = t.latitude AND lg.longitude = t.longitude
  WHERE
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.time) BETWEEN 2018 AND 2019
  GROUP BY
    t.latitude,
    t.longitude
)
SELECT
  latitude,
  longitude,
  ROUND(CAST(time_window_5 AS DECIMAL), 2) - 273.15 AS time_window_4
FROM time_window_3
ORDER BY
  latitude,
  longitude
